title: Shopify–NetSuite Sync for Personal Care Brands: Align Shades, Sizes, and Gift Sets
summary: Shopify variant IDs map to NetSuite items so each shade, size and gift-set revision stays distinct through orders and partial returns.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Personal-care two-way sync must preserve the exact shade, size, and set purchased on Shopify. Map stable variant IDs to approved ERP items or components, keeping merchandising names separate from product identity. A gift set needs its own versioned composition so orders and returns remain explainable after a seasonal assortment changes.


Explore the complete[personal care integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/personal-care) for the systems and processes around this guide.
